summary: Reproduced the Qwen-VL marker/data mismatch at the OpenAI chat-render to multimodal-loader boundary. Qwen-family multimodal requests now neutralize complete client-supplied vision marker sequences before the template emits authoritative attachment markers. A real PNG plus literal user or tool text reaches the loader as exactly one attachment; text-only input remains text; malformed image references remain request-validation errors.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: the rendered prompt contained two complete Qwen vision markers for one image in both user-text and tool-result cases.

Four focused tests passed with nine subtests: real 1x1 PNG data-URL decoding after actual chat rendering, literal user and tool text, text-only input, expanded and partial parser boundaries, and malformed attachment schema rejection.
160 tests and 92 subtests passed across OpenAI chat rendering, multimodal bad-input classification, and actual image decoding.

tests.what_was_measured: ROCm GPU execution on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950): [[1,2],[3,4]] squared produced [[7,10],[15,22]], exactly matching the independent CPU reference.
No whitespace errors in the patch.

gpu_execution_evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 reported one AMD Instinct MI350X device and executed a deterministic matrix multiplication matching an explicit CPU reference exactly. The parser regression itself is CPU-only.
remaining_limitations: Qwen3.8-27B weights were not available in the prepared environment, so a full model-server launch and semantic generation were not performed.

The deterministic tiny Llama fixture was not used because it can validate transport/engine execution only and cannot exercise or qualify the Qwen-VL chat template or multimodal processor architecture.

The fix is verified through the checked-out OpenAI request models, actual _apply_jinja_template implementation, actual load_mm_data dispatch, and real image decoding; it is not a claim of Qwen3.8-27B inference validation.
No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
